info.name: Climate Platform API
info.description:
Climate Intelligence & Disaster Management Platform backend. Phase 1: Foundation & Authentication. Phase 2: Admin Geography.

Run **Auth > Firebase: sign in** first; its post-response script stores the Firebase ID token in `{{accessToken}}`, which every API request sends as a Bearer token. No request contains a hardcoded token.

Example responses were captured by running each request against the real Express app with the database and Firebase replaced by in-memory fakes.

request.description: Unauthenticated liveness probe (outside /api/v1).

item.name: Auth
item.description: Sign-up and sign-in go straight to Firebase Authentication (this API never sees a password), then the API is called with the resulting ID token.

exec: // Token chaining: store the Firebase ID token for every other request in the collection.

request.description: Creates a Firebase Authentication account (Firebase Auth REST API). Also stores the returned ID token.

exec: // Token chaining: store the Firebase ID token for every other request in the collection.

request.description: Signs in with email/password against Firebase Authentication and stores the ID token in {{accessToken}}. ID tokens expire after one hour; re-run this to refresh.
Returns the backend's view of the signed-in user. The first call for a new Firebase account creates its users row at role general_public. Any role.
Administrator only. Offset-paginated: ?page (default 1) & pageSize (default 25, max 100).

response.name: 400 Validation failed
403 Role not permitted

request.description: Administrator only.

response.name: 403 Role not permitted

request.description: Administrator only. Sets role and/or scopeAdminUnitId. Only emergency_responder and government_official may have a non-null scopeAdminUnitId. An administrator cannot change their own access.

response.name: 400 Validation failed
400 Scope not allowed for role
403 Role not permitted
403 Cannot change own access

item.name: Admin Geography
item.description: Phase 2: countries, admin units (state, LGAs, wards), data sources and the import pipeline. Example responses were captured from the real app against a scratch PostGIS database loaded with the real Phase 2 files (Firebase token checks stubbed). Long GeoJSON examples use a small bbox.

item.name: Countries
item.description: Countries and the names of their levels (Nigeria: State, LGA, Ward). Reads: any signed-in user. Writes: Administrator only.

request.description: Every country with its levels and how many areas each level has.
One country with its per-level area counts. The code is ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 and is case-insensitive.

response.name: 400 Validation failed

request.description: Administrator only. Creates a country with its level names, top first. `bbox` [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] is optional: when set, imported shapes outside it fail their checks. No areas are created here; they arrive through Imports.

response.name: 400 Validation failed
403 Role not permitted
409 Country already exists

request.description: Administrator only. Change countryName, levelNames (rename, add, or reorder) and/or bbox. A level that already holds areas can be renamed but never removed; renaming updates every area's level_name in the same transaction.

response.name: 400 Level already has areas
403 Role not permitted

item.name: Admin units
item.description: The state, its LGAs and wards. Read-only for any signed-in user; areas are only ever written by promoting an import. Lists never carry shapes (standard section 10).

request.description: Paged list of names, codes and levels with a bbox/centroid summary and child count. No shapes. Filters: countryCode, level, parentId, q (name contains). Stores the first row's id in {{adminUnitId}}.

response.name: 400 Validation failed

request.description: One area with its parent, source, child count and full shape (the only reply besides the map layer that carries one).

response.name: 400 Validation failed

request.description: The wards of an LGA, or the LGAs of the state. No shapes.

Shapes for the map, only inside the visible area. `bbox` is required (a request without one is refused). Optional `zoom` simplifies shapes to about one screen pixel; optional countryCode and parentId narrow it.

response.name: 400 bbox missing

request.description: Point-in-polygon (ST_Contains): the state, LGA and ward containing [lon, lat], top level first. 404 when no mapped area contains the point, e.g. anywhere outside Rivers State.

response.name: 400 Validation failed
404 Point outside Rivers State (Lagos)
